title: Promotion Exam: Scoring Chiitoitsu
description: A promotion exam with no yaku shown: count the han of a riichi mahjong chiitoitsu (seven pairs) hand and answer the score at 25 fu. You can make at most one mistake
questionPrompt: Answer the score for this win
koTsumoScore: Score (from each non-dealer / from the dealer)

howToPlay.title: Question format
howToPlay.lead: You will get hands won with chiitoitsu. The yaku are not shown, so count the han yourself and answer the score from the 25 fu column of the scoring table.
